name: Golden Plains
summary: Across central Mulgore, the Golden Plains lie southeast of Thunder Bluff. Tauren hunt in this sunlit basin as wandering kodo herds graze.

sections.title: Heart of the Hunt
sections.body: Below Thunder Bluff’s towering mesas, golden and green grasses spread across Mulgore’s wild heart. Nomadic tauren cherish these traditional hunting grounds, where wildlife thrives. Broad kodo herds roam the basin, and hunters tell stories of legendary quarry. One is the great kodo Arra'chea, wandering through the tall grass.

faq.answer: The Golden Plains stretch southeast of Thunder Bluff across central Mulgore. Tauren cherish this broad grassland basin as a traditional hunting ground, with wide vistas and abundant wildlife.

faq.q: What animals roam the Golden Plains?
faq.answer: Wild kodo herds roam the basin alongside other native creatures of Mulgore. The most famous is Arra'chea, an elusive and revered kodo said to wander these grasslands.

faq.q: Why is this area important to the tauren?
faq.answer: The plains provide game and hides for the newly founded settlements across Mulgore. They also keep alive the tauren tradition of tracking and honoring their quarry.

angles.text: For the tauren, the Golden Plains embody their homeland’s bounty. Sacred hunting grounds spread beneath the shadow of Thunder Bluff.
These broad plains and their roaming kodo herds give hunters open ground to track legendary beasts like Arra'chea.
